guardrails_pointer_prefix: Guardrails are shared by the LLM gateway and MCP servers, so changes apply to both. They are used by applied guardrails in
guardrails_empty_description: Add a guardrail to choose and configure a check.
guardrails_load_service_options: Load all types from the service
guardrails_no_settings: This guardrail type has no settings.
guardrails_test_save_first: Save the guardrail to test it.
guardrails_test_description: Runs the saved settings against sample text. Save changes before testing them.
guardrails_cannot_redact: This guardrail can't locate findings, so redacting policies and filters block instead.
guardrails_filter_type_description: Runs guardrails on MCP traffic inside Obot. No server is deployed for this filter.
guardrails_filter_action_block_descripti: Rejects the tool call or result when any guardrail finds a problem.
guardrails_filter_action_redact_descript: Masks what the guardrails find and lets the rest through.
guardrails_filter_var_user: Caller, with user.id and user.groups (the IDs of their auth provider groups)
guardrails_filter_guardrails_description: Any finding from any selected guardrail triggers the action.
guardrails_filter_no_guardrails: No guardrails yet. Create one with "New guardrail".
guardrails_filter_missing_guardrails_one: A selected guardrail no longer exists: {ids}
guardrails_filter_missing_guardrails_oth: Some selected guardrails no longer exist: {ids}
guardrails_filter_direction_description: Which side of the tool call is checked.
guardrails_filter_sampling_rate_invalid: Sampling rate must be between 1 and 100
guardrails_filter_sampling_rate_descript: Percentage of matching traffic the filter checks.
guardrails_filter_fail_closed_descriptio: Block the call when a guardrail can't be evaluated.
guardrails_filter_non_redacting_one: {names} can't locate findings for redaction. Findings from it will block instead.
guardrails_filter_non_redacting_other: {names} can't locate findings for redaction. Findings from them will block instead.
guardrails_filter_block_message_placehol: Leave empty for the default message
guardrails_filter_subjects_description: Limit this filter to calls from these users and groups.
guardrails_filter_subjects_empty: Not limited to anyone. The filter applies to everyone.
guardrails_filter_condition_description_: expression. The filter only runs when it is true.
guardrails_type_configured_tooltip: Already configured as {names}. Edit the existing one to change it, or add another, for example with different settings.
guardrails_type_regex_description: Matches content against regular expressions, with ready-made patterns for common personal data.
guardrails_type_regex_field_pii_template: Built-in patterns to use. Phone numbers are North American, or international with their + country code; IP addresses are IPv4 or IPv6; IBANs may be grouped by spaces. Credit card numbers and IBANs are confirmed with a checksum.
guardrails_type_regex_field_patterns_des: One pattern per entry, in RE2 syntax. Name a pattern with LABEL=pattern, e.g. {example}.
guardrails_type_llm_judge_description: Evaluates content against a policy written in plain language, using the default mini model with a second review by the default model before blocking.
guardrails_type_llm_judge_field_definiti: What should or should not be allowed, e.g. "Do not help book travel above economy class."
guardrails_type_secrets_description: Detects leaked API keys, tokens, private keys and connection strings for AWS, GitHub, GitLab, Slack, Stripe, Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure and more.
guardrails_type_secrets_field_generic_de: Flag high-entropy values assigned to names like api_key, access_key, client_secret, token or password.
guardrails_type_secrets_field_min_entrop: Shannon entropy in bits per character; higher values flag fewer strings.
guardrails_type_aws_bedrock_description: Checks content with an Amazon Bedrock guardrail's denied topics, content filters, word filters, sensitive information filters and contextual grounding checks. Content the guardrail anonymizes is redacted with its masked text.
guardrails_type_aws_bedrock_field_region: AWS region of the guardrail, such as us-east-1.
guardrails_type_aws_bedrock_field_guardr: A version number, or DRAFT for the working draft.
guardrails_type_aws_bedrock_field_access: Leave empty to use the default AWS credential chain (environment, shared config, or IAM role).
guardrails_type_aws_bedrock_field_endpoi: Overrides the Bedrock runtime endpoint, such as a VPC endpoint. Defaults to https://bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com.
guardrails_type_azure_content_safety_des: Detects hateful, sexual, violent and self-harm content with Azure AI Content Safety, and optionally prompt injection attacks with Prompt Shields.
guardrails_type_azure_content_safety_fie: The Content Safety resource endpoint, e.g. https://my-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com.
Harm categories to check. Leave empty to check all of them.
Severity (0, 2, 4 or 6) at which content counts as a finding.
Also check user prompts for jailbreak attempts and tool results for indirect prompt injection, on input.
guardrails_type_azure_language_pii_descr: Detects personal and health data with Azure AI Language PII detection, and locates it for redaction.
guardrails_type_azure_language_pii_field: Language code of the analyzed text.
Use phi to also detect protected health information.
PII categories to detect, e.g. Email, PhoneNumber or USSocialSecurityNumber. Leave empty to detect every category.
Confidence from 0 to 1 an entity needs to count as a finding.
guardrails_type_crowdstrike_aidr_descrip: Screens prompts, responses and tool traffic with CrowdStrike Falcon AI Detection and Response (AI Guard) for malicious prompts, PII, secrets, malicious entities, topics and more. Content AI Guard redacts is replaced with its redacted text.
guardrails_type_crowdstrike_aidr_field_a: Token of an AIDR collector; the collector's policy decides what is detected.
Optional application identifier recorded with each event.
guardrails_type_crowdstrike_aidr_field_c: Optional identifier of this Obot deployment, recorded with each event.
guardrails_type_google_model_armor_descr: Screens prompts and responses with a Google Cloud Model Armor template: responsible AI, prompt injection and jailbreak, malicious URL, CSAM and Sensitive Data Protection filters. Sensitive data is redacted when the template inspects or de-identifies it.
guardrails_type_google_model_armor_field: Google Cloud project that holds the template.
The template's location, such as us-central1.
Leave empty to use application default credentials. The account needs the Model Armor User role.
Overrides the Model Armor endpoint. Defaults to https://modelarmor.<location>.rep.googleapis.com. Without a service account key, only Model Armor endpoints on googleapis.com are allowed.
guardrails_type_lakera_description: Screens conversations with Lakera Guard, now part of Check Point, for prompt attacks, PII, content violations, unknown links and custom detectors. PII, profanity and custom regex matches are redacted.
guardrails_type_lakera_field_project_id_: The Lakera project whose policy screens the content, deciding which detectors run and how confident they must be. Leave empty to use the default policy with the minimum confidence below.
guardrails_type_lakera_field_min_confide: Without a project, the least confident result that counts. Lakera's default policy flags results down to l4_less_likely, which includes some ordinary prompts. Ignored when a project is set.
guardrails_type_lakera_field_base_url_de: Change for a regional or self-hosted deployment.
guardrails_type_presidio_description: Detects personal data with a self-hosted Microsoft Presidio Analyzer, and locates it for redaction.
guardrails_type_presidio_field_analyzer_: Base URL of the Presidio Analyzer service, e.g. http://presidio-analyzer:3000.
guardrails_type_presidio_field_language_: Language code of the analyzed text.
guardrails_type_presidio_field_entities_: Entity types to detect. With none chosen, the default personal data types are used.
guardrails_type_presidio_field_score_thr: Confidence from 0 to 1 an entity needs to count as a finding.
guardrails_type_presidio_field_api_key_d: Sent as a bearer token, for analyzers behind an authenticating proxy.
guardrails_type_patronus_description: Evaluates prompts and responses with Patronus AI evaluators, such as its toxicity and PII detectors or LLM judges with managed or custom criteria.
guardrails_type_patronus_field_evaluator: One evaluator per entry, as evaluator or evaluator:criteria, e.g. judge:patronus:is-harmful-advice, pii or toxicity.
guardrails_finding_prompt_attack: Prompt attack detected in the user prompt
guardrails_finding_indirect_prompt_attac: Indirect prompt attack detected in a tool result
guardrails_finding_prompt_injection_conf: Prompt injection or jailbreak attempt ({confidence} confidence)
